_comment: M2.3 activity definitions and interaction points for Sector 01 / Left Wing / Floor 1. Source of truth for Content/CyberWarden/Schedule/DA_S01_LW_F1_Activities (generated by Tools/ConfigureActivities.py, validated by Tools/ValidateActivities.py). An interaction point is keyed by the destination marker id used in the schedule JSON, so it applies to every NPC that goes there. Every animation is optional; missing ones degrade to the normal idle pose.

activities._note: PLACEHOLDER pose: the existing Manny idle (MM_Idle). The activity is the purposeful alignment (facing the TV) until a real watching/leaning animation is acquired for Stage B/C.

M2.3 Stage C1: generic sit-and-wait (stand-to-sit, seated idle loop, sit-to-stand; Mixamo clips retargeted in C0). No interaction point uses it yet: the seat points, the stool and the Move To stop distance are Stage C2. The clip pelvis travels 43 cm backwards while sitting (see Docs/NPC/M2_3_Stage_C0.md, the 88 cm table gap).

interaction_points._note: M2.3 Stage C2 prototype seat (QUI01 breakfast / lunch / dinner). Faces -Y: the table (Prop_Caf_Table_1, y -150..-50) is on the -Y side of the marker (y -5). A tight tolerance asks Move To for its 10 cm radius floor; Move To still stops 40-47 cm out (Phase 1 measurement), so the final approach then walks the NPC to the exact marker.
